name: The Rebels
description: The Rebels were a greaser-era street gang active in the Bushwick area of Brooklyn, New York in the early 1960s, centered around Wyckoff Avenue and the Halsey Street corridor. Known contemporaries and rivals in the area included the Saints and the Stompers.
